offer.text: It's... a strange thing to ask. Someone I loved is buried past the hill. Would you lay 3 poppies there for me? My legs won't carry me that far anymore.

accept.text: Thank you. Tell them — no, just lay the flowers. They'll know.

decline.text: Of course. It's too much to ask a near-stranger.

in_progress.text: Have you been to the hill yet?

ready.text: You did it. You actually did it. Bless you.

complete.text: I haven't trusted anyone with that in years. You're not a stranger anymore.
